title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：vision　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vision 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the elder ① had the vision that no youth in the village would have noted, and he said the having was the whole of the year. The ② vision, meaning the sight itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; vision, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ bit of vision in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ vision at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Vision, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the elder said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the vision was the whole of the matter, meaning the imagination and not the sight. The ⑥ vision, meaning the imagination and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; vision, he said, is either something you have or the only word that means both sight and an imagination. He said the imagination is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ vision had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ vision of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of noting; vision, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ vision I remember is the vision noted in the memoir, which closed in 1979 and is still noted as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Vision, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all vision, she said, is an imagination that has agreed to look like sight. She said the imagination was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 视力；愿景（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 视力；愿景（指那份视力本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：have the vision 怀有这一份视力
D. n. 视力；愿景（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 视力之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的视力之事）
F. n. 视力；愿景（指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 视力、远见（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 远见（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: had the vision that no youth in the village would have noted
The vision, meaning the sight itself and not the staff
Every bit of vision in that village
the vision at the far gate
the vision was the whole of the matter
the vision had become a line in a memoir
The vision of the whole thing

answers.why: have the vision 意为“怀有这一份视力”，1972 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记下的一份视力做了一遍。
vision 意为“视力；愿景”，指那份视力本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
vision 意为“视力；愿景”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
vision 意为“视力；愿景”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
vision 意为“视力、远见”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份远见就是那件事的全部。
vision 意为“远见”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份视力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
vision 意为“视力；愿景”，指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1977 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
vision 意为“视力之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的视力之事是一处村子和三个年头的记下。
vision 意为“视力；愿景”，我记得的是回忆录里记下过的那一份，1979 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
vision 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，视力是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的视力。
